info.title: ktsu.GitLfsCache.Tool
info.description: A caching reverse proxy for the Git LFS HTTP API. Relays every Batch API call upstream so upstream remains the sole authority on access, rewrites the returned transfer URLs to point at itself, and serves object bytes from a local content-addressed store. A cache miss is fetched from upstream once and stored on the way through, so the next request for that object is local. Ships as a dotnet tool and as a container image for Kubernetes.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: A caching reverse proxy for the Git LFS HTTP API.

options.name: --port
options.description: Port to listen on. Defaults to 8080.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to a JSON configuration file to load. Layered over any appsettings.json in the working directory, and still overridden by the flags below.

options.name: --store
options.description: Directory to cache objects in. Defaults to a per-user application data directory.

options.name: --max-size
options.description: Cache byte budget, for example 500GB or 500Gi.

options.name: --token-key
options.description: Base64 encoded 32 byte key protecting rewritten transfer URLs. Generated for this run when omitted.

options.name: --public-base-url
options.description: Externally reachable base URL to build transfer URLs from. Derived from each request when omitted.

options.name: --upstream
options.description: An upstream as name=url, for example github=https://github.com. Repeatable.

options.name: --allow
options.description: A repository path pattern an upstream may serve, as name=pattern, for example github=studio/**. Repeatable. Required at least once per upstream.
